solution.p: We have to substitute {{\frac{6}{7}}} in for x and simplify each side. The left side simplifies to {-{\frac{3}{35}}} and the right side simplifies to {{\frac{22}{35}}}\text{.} Since these are not equal, {{\frac{6}{7}}} is not a solution to {2x-{\frac{9}{5}}}={7x-{\frac{188}{35}}}\text{.}
